definitions.explanation: A wide knitted band worn around the stomach under clothing to keep the belly warm, believed in Japan to prevent stomach upsets and chills.

examples.japanese: {腹巻|はらま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: To sleep wearing a belly warmer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腹巻|はらま}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手放|てばな}せない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: In winter I can't do without my belly warmer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腹巻|はらま}き⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いえば⟦おじさん→おじさん：00803_ojisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧な⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Belly warmers used to be something only middle-aged men wore, but now there are more stylish ones.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Keeping the stomach warm is a common health concern in Japan: children are told not to sleep with their bellies uncovered, and the {腹巻|はらま}き is the old-fashioned remedy, long associated with middle-aged men (the film hero Tora-san wears one). Lighter, stylish versions are now sold for women.
